audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 6 are credited to Vladimir/Skill while the packet chart and the matching whys all say Nautilus owns them.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 and is not ranked early; without it Vladimir has no answer to Dredge Line into the passive root, and at 6 Depth Charge plus Riptide holds an out-of-pool Vladimir for the kill.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3 and 6 to Nautilus; First item and 2+ items stay Vladimir.

audit.why: Spikes are levels 2-3, level 6, his first AP item and full AP — the real order in which this lane flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is only mentioned once in itemization and never in the do's; Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetability and its cooldown are never numbered.
audit.why: Transfusion (Q, 9s down to 4.6s) and Hemoplague (R) both heal him, so anti-heal decides every extended trade; Sanguine Pool (W, 28/25/22/19/16s) makes him untargetable for 2s, which drops Dredge Line and Depth Charge in flight.
audit.corrected: State the 2s untargetable window with its 28s rank-1 cooldown and make Grievous Wounds an explicit rule.

edits.before: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Until he ranks Sanguine Pool, your hook into passive root wins every short trade he tries to take.

edits.before: He’s AP — build MR, Q-hook his early. Nautilus wins the Sanguine Pool cooldown windows.
edits.after: He's all AP — buy MR and Grievous Wounds, and hook him while Sanguine Pool is down.

edits.before: Dodges your CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 2s untargetable, 28s at rank 1 — bait it, then hook it down.

edits.before: That is Vladimir's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Crimson Pact turns his AP into health — buy MR and Grievous Wounds, armour does nothing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Pool eats Q and R in flight — throw them after his W, never into it.

notes: Rows 1, 2 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart and their own whys; flipped as a paired group. Anti-heal requirement from missingInteractions surfaced into the TL;DR and don'ts.
